mapper.select: select lease_type as leaseType,total_time as totalTime,lessee,revenue_money as revenueMoney,lease_date as leaseDate,asset_code as assetCode, asset_name as assetName,contract_number as contractNumber,approval_status as approvalStatus,approval_date as approvalDate from asset_lease

select lease_type as leaseType,total_time as totalTime,lessee,revenue_money as revenueMoney,lease_date as leaseDate,asset_code as assetCode, asset_name as assetName,contract_number as contractNumber,approval_status as approvalStatus,approval_date as approvalDate from asset_lease where approval_status = '未审核'
mapper.update: update asset_lease set approval_status = '已审核',approval_date = NOW() where asset_code = #{code}
update asset_info set note = '租借中',lease = 1 where code = #{code};
update asset_lease set approval_status = '已审核',approval_date = NOW() where asset_code = #{code}
mapper.select: select code,name,type,max_type,dept,unit,life,amount,use_status,review_status,approval_date,note,lease from asset_info where review_status = '已通过' and lease = 0

SELECT revenue_money as revenueMoney,sale_time as saleTime, receiver, asset_code as assetCode, asset_name as assetName,asset_value as assetValue,contract_number as contractNumber,approval_status as approvalStatus,approval_date as approvalDate FROM asset_sale

SELECT revenue_money as revenueMoney,sale_time as saleTime, receiver, asset_code as assetCode, asset_name as assetName,asset_value as assetValue,contract_number as contractNumber,approval_status as approvalStatus,approval_date as approvalDate FROM asset_sale where approval_status = '未审核'
mapper.insert: insert into asset_sale(revenue_money,sale_time, receiver, asset_code,asset_name, asset_value ,contract_number,approval_status) values (#{revenueMoney},#{saleTime},#{receiver},#{assetCode},#{assetName},#{assetValue},#{contractNumber},#{approvalStatus})
mapper.update: update asset_sale set approval_status = '已通过',approval_date = NOW() where asset_code = #{code}
update asset_sale set approval_status = '已审核',approval_date = NOW() where asset_code = #{code}
mapper.select: select contract_number as contractNumber,contract_type as contractType,party_a as partyA,party_b as partyB,signing_date as signingDate,termination_date as terminationDate from contract where contract_type = '变卖合同'

select contract_number as contractNumber,contract_type as contractType,party_a as partyA,party_b as partyB,signing_date as signingDate,termination_date as terminationDate from contract where contract_type = '租借合同'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract (contract_number, contract_type, party_a, party_b, signing_date) VALUES (#{contractNumber}, #{contractType}, #{partyA}, #{partyB}, NOW())
INSERT INTO contract (contract_number, contract_type, party_a, party_b, signing_date, termination_date) VALUES (#{contractNumber}, #{contractType}, #{partyA}, #{partyB}, NOW(), #{terminationDate})
mapper.select: select income_type as incomeType,asset_code as assetCode,asset_name as assetName, income_amount as incomeAmount,entry_status as entryStatus,entry_time as entryTime from in_come
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO in_come (income_type, asset_code, asset_name, income_amount, entry_status, entry_time) VALUES (#{incomeType}, #{assetCode}, #{assetName}, #{incomeAmount}, '已入账', NOW());
